instructional_resource_reference.status: accepted prerequisite; no resource rows copied into this stock-only first slice

manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp439-445 says Control.APID selects the POINT group in StockAllocation, ResourceAllocation and MaintenanceAllocation; StockAllocation.STSIZ is nominal stock and POINT/IID/STID uniquely key its rows. Dictionary pins Control.APID and StockAllocation's nine columns. This first slice isolates stock POINT selection; resource and maintenance allocation remain separate I01 stages.
source_delta: Accepted E01 has AIR_BASIC APID and one TEACH-LRU-01 BASE-01 StockAllocation row with STSIZ1. The stocked control adds an AIR_EMPTY row for the same IID/STID with STSIZ0 and changes description, retaining APID AIR_BASIC. The child changes only Control.APID AIR_BASIC→AIR_EMPTY and description; both arms include both POINT rows, the same aircraft, ordinary LRU failure, explicit half-hour system replacement task, item repair, seed1, three missions and horizon36. ResourceAllocation remains empty and MaintenanceAllocation absent in both arms.

pre_run_hypotheses.stocked: The APID AIR_BASIC arm should select one local spare and reproduce the accepted E01 physical replacement/repair behavior despite the inactive AIR_EMPTY row.
pre_run_hypotheses.empty: The APID AIR_EMPTY arm should initialize no local spare at BASE-01. After the same ordinary LRU failure, the native log and stock ledger must decide whether replacement waits, procurement occurs, the aircraft remains unavailable, or a fallback path activates. No particular cancellation or replenishment behavior is preaccepted.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, an unexpected spare, no observable APID effect, report/stock inconsistency or unsealed native step is diagnostic until explained. The shared E01 failure draw might shift after APID changes.

acceptance_gates: Accepted E01 direct parent, independent pre-run static review of exact delta, manual/dictionary basis and guarded runner
Fresh serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
Exact authored-table roundtrip, zero converter errors and valid output/report in both arms
Physical stock initialization and item issue/backorder, mission/failure/replacement events, 72-bin System/Stock ledger and terminal state reconcile
SHA-256 sealed raw evidence and independent read-only post-run replay
limits: This is stock-only APID POINT selection. It does not establish simultaneous selection across MaintenanceAllocation and ResourceAllocation, task category/level filtering, APID blank, STID=<NONE>, StationVariant, shortages with procurement, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
One spare versus zero at one station with one seed cannot prove general demand, reorder or multi-station behavior.
